proposed_from.topic: Calendar-exhaustion covariance frontier for staggered-DiD calendar effects. In the exact known-covariance Gaussian not-yet-treated score experiment generated by fixed cohort-stratified repeated cross sections, characterize global minimax MSE and shortest uniformly honest expected length for a Holder-smooth late-calendar ATT while bounded cohort deviations remain unrestricted. Work uniformly over growing T, N/T>=1, and 1<=m<=delta T. Derive the nested covariance, phase diagram, attaining estimator and interval/band, matched lower bounds, and exact fixed-marginal diagonal-order comparison. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: sparse coefficient algebra yields an exhaustion component and nested common floor, verified numerically for T=3,...,8. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: uniform bounded lifts with matched information. EARLY KILL TEST: dimension-free lift and Mahalanobis-energy bounds for canonical boundary bumps.

seed_details.anchor: BorusyakJaravelSpiess2024, Section 3.4 and Proposition 5; Donoho1994, Sections 1--3
seed_details.question: Characterize the minimax squared-error frontier for the terminal calendar ATT when valid not-yet-treated comparisons stop \(m\) periods before the terminal date and the score covariance is inherited from repeated cross sections.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The direct-regression modulus in Donoho becomes a constrained right-inverse problem because a calendar bump must be represented by observed cohort-time effects while unobserved cohort deviations satisfy a uniform bound.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for staggered DiD, late-calendar ATT, smooth extrapolation, nested covariance, and minimax risk returned no paper occupying this target--method pair.
seed_details.red_team: Objection: this is immediate from Donoho's Gaussian modulus theory. Rebuttal: the modulus is not known until the staggered score covariance is derived and the terminal bump is lifted through the bounded cohort surface with dimension-free information control.

seed_details.anchor: RambachanRoth2023, Sections 3--4 and Proposition 4.1; ArmstrongKolesar2018, Section 3 and Theorem 3.1
seed_details.question: Find the shortest uniformly honest expected length for the same terminal ATT and determine when its tuning differs from minimax MSE tuning.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The ordered modulus must be computed under the non-diagonal exhaustion experiment rather than for a reduced event-study coefficient vector with a supplied covariance.
seed_details.destination_search: The exact combination of terminal calendar extrapolation, bounded cohort heterogeneity, and a shrinking not-yet-treated covariance was absent from the honest DiD and optimal-inference results located.
seed_details.red_team: Objection: Armstrong and Kolesar already solve Gaussian honest intervals over convex classes. Rebuttal: their result supplies the decision-theoretic shell, while the new theorem computes the DiD-specific modulus, attainable weights, and exhaustion phase frontier.

seed_details.anchor: SantAnnaZhao2020, Proposition 1; BorusyakJaravelSpiess2024, Appendix A.4; CohenFogarty2022, covariance-order argument based on Anderson's theorem
seed_details.question: Give an exact diagonal-order criterion comparing nested and independent Gaussian experiments with identical coordinate variances for late-calendar estimation and honest inference.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Loewner ordering must be replaced by an information-profile comparison restricted to the Holder-plus-bounded-nuisance difference body.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for equal-diagonal Gaussian covariance ordering of minimax linear-functional risk found no parameter-class-specific criterion in DiD.
seed_details.red_team: Objection: covariance comparison is a routine matrix inequality. Rebuttal: equal diagonals rule out nontrivial Loewner dominance, and the sign can reverse with the least-favorable direction, so an iff information-profile criterion is required.

seed_details.anchor: CallawaySantAnna2021, Section 4 and Theorem 2; GenoveseWasserman2008, Theorems 1--2
seed_details.question: Characterize minimax maximum width for an honest simultaneous band over the last \(m\) calendar ATTs.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The scalar least-favorable pair must be replaced by a packing of terminal bumps whose Gaussian width is evaluated under the nested covariance.
seed_details.destination_search: Existing staggered-DiD bands treat identified group-time effects and do not optimize terminal extrapolation width.
seed_details.red_team: Objection: add a supremum critical value to the pointwise interval. Rebuttal: growing \(m\) changes both the least-favorable packing and covariance geometry, so pointwise weights need not attain band width.
seed_details.disposition: deferred because the scalar lift must be settled first

seed_details.anchor: ArmstrongKolesar2020, Sections 2--3 and Theorem 1; Donoho1994, modulus lower-bound construction
seed_details.question: Construct a dimension-free lift of each canonical terminal Holder bump into a bounded cohort-time surface while preserving Mahalanobis energy.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace direct insertion of an optimal-recovery bump into the observed regression mean by a bounded right inverse of the cohort-observation map.
seed_details.destination_search: No right-inverse or bounded-lift theorem for the not-yet-treated DiD operator was located.
seed_details.red_team: Objection: set every cohort deviation equal to the bump. Rebuttal: that violates the calendar-centering restriction or accumulates with \(T\), and it need not preserve the covariance-weighted information.
seed_details.disposition: merged as the central lower-bound lemma

seed_details.question: Derive a tangent-cone efficiency bound for a late-calendar ATT under calendar smoothness and bounded cohort heterogeneity.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The regular repeated-cross-section influence-function projection becomes a nonregular tangent-cone problem at the extrapolation boundary.
seed_details.destination_search: No late-calendar tangent-cone bound was found, but the nonvanishing extrapolation bias prevents a regular efficiency interpretation when \(m/T\) stays positive.
seed_details.red_team: Objection: Sant'Anna and Zhao already give the repeated-cross-section efficiency bound. Rebuttal: their ATT is pointwise identified; nevertheless, the proposed smooth-extrapolation target is generally nonregular, so a classical efficiency bound is the wrong headline.
seed_details.disposition: dropped because the regular efficiency lane is obstructed by partial extrapolation

seed_details.question: Derive the limit law of optimally tuned late-calendar ATT estimators as the exhaustion floor crosses the smoothness scale.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The fixed-weight central limit theorem must be replaced by triangular optimal weights whose concentration changes with \(m\), \(N\), and \(T\).
seed_details.destination_search: Borusyak, Jaravel, and Spiess allow slow growth of \(T\), but no transition law for terminal calendar extrapolation was found.
seed_details.red_team: Objection: the experiment is exactly Gaussian, so every affine estimator is already Gaussian. Rebuttal: only data-dependent tuning could create a nontrivial transition law, which would add complexity without improving the fixed-class kernel.
seed_details.disposition: dropped because exact Gaussianity makes the fixed-tuning limit law immediate

seed_details.anchor: ArmstrongKolesar2018, Section 3.4; Bull2012, adaptation impossibility and self-similarity construction
seed_details.question: Determine the weakest self-similarity restriction permitting adaptation to unknown Holder exponent under calendar exhaustion.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct multiscale contrasts after whitening by the nested score covariance rather than under independent regression errors.
seed_details.destination_search: No covariance-aware self-similarity theory for staggered-DiD terminal effects was found.
seed_details.red_team: Objection: Lepski adaptation is standard. Rebuttal: honest adaptation is impossible over the unmodified centrosymmetric Holder union, and the minimal extra restriction under exhaustion is not known.
seed_details.disposition: retained only as the open-ended extension

seed_details.question: Choose a treatment policy using a late-calendar ATT forecast and prove welfare-regret bounds.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: A decision class and identified welfare score would have to replace the fixed calendar ATT functional.
seed_details.destination_search: The source defines effect aggregation but supplies no policy class or welfare decision; the requested design fixes staggered adoption rather than choosing treatment.
seed_details.red_team: Objection: this simply wraps the estimator in empirical welfare maximization. Rebuttal: the objection holds because no policy decision is part of the supplied causal design.
seed_details.disposition: dropped; named search obstruction is the absence of a treatment-policy object

seed_details.question: Invert cohort permutations to obtain a finite-sample terminal-ATT confidence set.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: An exact group action preserving cohort adoption dates and the Holder calendar path would be required.
seed_details.destination_search: No exchangeability group compatible with fixed unequal cohort shares and staggered adoption was found.
seed_details.red_team: Objection: permute cohort labels. Rebuttal: the objection fails as a method because adoption dates, control pools, and covariance all change under that permutation, so exact symmetry is absent.
seed_details.disposition: dropped; named search obstruction is the absence of a valid finite-sample symmetry
